anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, highly convex cranial arc characterized by a large pixel radius, forming a bulbous silhouette that dominates the anterior-dorsal profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely low aspect ratio; the visible rostrum is a short, blunt projection with a thickness nearly equivalent to its length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: High-degree obtuse angle where the vertical curve of the melon meets the short horizontal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple discrete, light-toned circular and linear markings are visible on the dorsal melon surface, including a prominent circular depigmented spot near the cranial apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive mottling across the visible dermal surface characterized by high-contrast white and cyan-grey patches; dark ocular aperture visible on the lateral flank of the head.
